CustomField.description: Internal: the AsyncApexJob Id of the run's batch job (RosterIntakeBatch), stored when the run starts. Used to abort the job when the run is cancelled, and to detect a run left Queued or Running by a job that ended without finishing it (RosterIntakeRunService.failAbandonedRuns), so it can be marked Failed with the job's error.
CustomField.label: Last Job ID
